description: Read one page of current consented website-reported activity for campaignId or personId (u_ account only). Page size 25; use nextCursor. External orders are site attestations, not verified ticket payments. Revoked, expired, erased and unavailable connections are excluded. No visitor consent or sending action is exposed. Workflow guide (MCP resource): socialloop://guides/email-campaigns.
